projects.name: Mundo Premier
projects.desc: An interactive online experience designed to engage members of Club Premier.

sections.label: Overview
sections.title: All about Mundo Premier
sections.body:
Mundo Premier is an exciting mobile adventure game where players help Aerobot travel the world, collecting coins, gaining distance, and winning incredible prizes. With engaging gameplay and dynamic challenges, players aim to earn points and compete for rewards such as travel experiences, SUVs, and more.

Designed for Club Premier members, the game offers a unique opportunity to redeem travel points for exclusive chances to play and win. Mundo Premier was developed in collaboration with Aeromexico, Club Premier, Santander, and sponsored by Visa and GMC, combining fun, travel rewards, and brand partnerships into one immersive experience.

sections.title: Challenge / Problem statement
sections.intro: Club Premier was looking for a strategic and reliable provider capable of developing interactive experiences for its advertising campaigns within a short development timeline and without any production errors, as any errors could lead to legal issues given the nature of the campaigns.
problems: Compliance with legal regulations governing games and sweepstakes for auditing purposes
approach: From day one, we offered a comprehensive solution in which the development timeline was tailored to the client’s desired launch schedule—in this case, a two-month timeline for public launch, with zero margin for error during the launch.

Through constant communication with the client throughout the development process, extensive testing in a staging environment, and stress testing to handle high traffic volumes, we successfully achieved our goal.

items.heading: Development
items.body: Development of the final, tested version over a two-month period

items.heading: Over 60,000 users
items.body: An experience enjoyed by more than 60,000 users (Club Premier members, now Aeromexico Rewards)

items.heading: No errors
items.body: There were no production errors that could have affected the user's score. This was very important, as there were big prizes up for grabs, such as trips and SUVs.

items.heading: Successful report
items.body: Weekly reports were submitted to verify the authenticity of each user's games, including a review of high scores in relation to game duration and the number of games redeemed.

sections.title: Conclussion
sections.body: An experience that turned loyalty points into an opportunity to win big prizes, thereby further strengthening member loyalty

hero.title: A software development company that builds custom solutions from day one

intro.heading: Who we are?
intro.body:
At JeeTP Studios, we design and build custom digital products: interactive experiences, video games, apps, and platforms. We’re a team of developers, designers, and strategists who serve as the technical arm of brands and agencies.

We operate like a factory, not an agency: with no layers of middlemen or unnecessary overhead. That means lower costs, realistic timelines, and the flexibility to scale according to each project.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.body:
We have developed experiences for loyalty programs, sports leagues, and commercial activations, combining technology with business objectives.

Every project begins with a brief conversation to understand what needs to be achieved; from there, we define the scope, timeline, and costs, and then we build it.

beliefs.heading: What do we believe in?
beliefs.body: We believe in building products that work for people, not the other way around. From research to design to testing, we don’t stop until we get it right.
